llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must represent collapsed/expanded states with a Reanimated progress shared value (for example `0`/`1`) and map it to card height via `interpolate(...)` in `useAnimatedStyle`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The progress shared value (expanded) is used, but height is NOT mapped via interpolate(...) in useAnimatedStyle. Instead, withSpring is called inside useAnimatedStyle to animate height directly, which is a different pattern than interpolate(progress, [0,1], [collapsedHeight, expandedHeight]).
evidence: height: withSpring(open ? detailsHeight.value : 0, SPRING_CONFIG) — no interpolate() call present

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Header press must toggle the progress shared value between collapsed/expanded states using `withSpring(...)` from `react-native-reanimated`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The toggle function sets expanded.value directly (expanded.value = expanded.value ? 0 : 1) without wrapping in withSpring(). The spring animation is applied inside useAnimatedStyle instead of on the shared value assignment.
evidence: No withSpring(...) call at the toggle/assignment site for expanded.value

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Card/details visuals must be driven by Reanimated animated styles (`Animated.View` + `useAnimatedStyle`) instead of direct non-animated React style toggles.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Card details are rendered inside Animated.View with useAnimatedStyle controlling height and opacity; no direct non-animated React style toggles are used to show/hide content.
